name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN took Bulambika 9 Nov; no major city fallen
summary: FRN fighters advanced 50–60km in South Kivu from 7 Nov, taking Bulambika; no major city has fallen
state: The FRN, the Kabila-led movement linked to AFC-M23, began an offensive in South Kivu on the night of 6–7 Nov, taking Bitale, Kambali and Bulambika along the RN3 through Kahuzi-Biega park; the army said it still held Mubugu and Hombo-Sud and was preparing a counter-offensive, and Kalehe's administrator put the displaced at over 160,000 (RFI via AllAfrica, 10 Nov). The FRN said on 6 Nov it faces the army, Burundian forces and allied militias in the Fizi-Uvira-Mwenga highlands (New Times). No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira or direct interstate fighting was found as of 17 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Little direct risk to UK readers; follow FCDO travel advice for the DRC. The east produces tin, tantalum and gold, so fighting can disrupt mineral supply chains, and it displaces large numbers of civilians.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting — FRN offensive in South Kivu from 7 Nov; no major city captured, no interstate fighting
